    "All four supplied fingerprints recompute exactly.     "The original T20 registration remains unchanged. These measurements qualify the supplied synthetic stream/chart workload, not live services or upload performance.",
    "Independent probes executed production TypeScript validation and React components entirely in memory with presentation/native-boundary stubs. They confirmed acceptance of the bounded post-upload shape, rejection of raw out-of-range timestamps, rendering of projected unknown times, correct edge-date formatting, explicit mismatched-delete uncertainty and visible incomplete answers. The upload-cache probe modeled the inspected Rust transformation; it did not independently execute a Core upload or network request.",
    "This pass covers C18's reviewed fixture-backed scope. Live service qualification remains C25 and signed installed-package qualification C26. The added C16 follow-up evidence and regression checks do not replace C16's separate review or the cumulative P05 gate. D045's explicitly excluded file purposes/downloads and other operations are not claimed as implemented.",
    "No application source was changed, product endpoints called or credentials accessed. No application build or on-disk application test was run for this review. Only the designated verdict artifact was written."
  ],
